description: This file contains test cases for the Vertex AI Anthropic integration, focusing on configuration parameters, header generation, and detection of web search tools within the context of Anthropic models used with Vertex AI.

classes.name: VertexAIAnthropicConfig
classes.description: Configuration class related to Anthropic models for Vertex AI, providing methods like get_supported_openai_params.

classes.name: AnthropicModelInfo
classes.description: Utility class that provides methods related to Anthropic model settings, such as detection of web search tools and header generation.

classes.name: AnthropicConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Anthropic models' header handling, including methods to update headers based on output format and request type.

methods.name: test_vertex_ai_anthropic_thinking_param(model, expected_thinking)
methods.description: Test to verify the presence or absence of the 'thinking' parameter in supported openai params based on model.

methods.name: test_get_supported_params_thinking()
methods.description: Test to check if the 'thinking' parameter is included in openai params for a specific model.

methods.name: test_vertex_ai_anthropic_web_search_header_in_completion()
methods.description: Test that ensures web search tools add the correct beta header for Vertex AI requests and are absent otherwise.

methods.name: test_vertex_ai_anthropic_structured_output_header_not_added()
methods.description: Test that structured output headers are not added for Vertex AI requests but are added for non-Vertex requests.
